body:
User asked (verbatim):
  same issue
  (screenshots: persona tab on accounts.google.com 'Sign in to continue to WorkOS' -> 'Something went wrong / Restart' after entering an email; then 'Cookies are disabled' at accounts.google.com/v3/signin/rejected)
  Earlier: 'just fix it man'

Context:
  After the document.cookie shim + request barrier fix (passes the Google-like fixture), real Google sign-in still fails in persona s2 on staging-app.franchisepartner.com (WorkOS AuthKit -> Sign in with Google). Remaining known MV3 gap: Set-Cookie on a redirect cannot reach the follow-up request; Google's sign-in leans on that plus many google.com cookies.

Acceptance:
  'Sign in with Google' from a persona tab completes and the persona ends signed in to the app as the chosen Google account, while the app session stays separate per persona.
title: Google sign-in fails inside a persona: let identity providers use the normal login (pass-through hosts)
